maturity_rule: Maturity is per member and per declared scope. PentaCompliance and PentaLicense have production internal control-plane runtimes with independent negative/stress evidence; binding attestations, rights decisions, contracts and provider effects remain independently gated. Other members remain non-execution-eligible until separately certified or promoted with exact evidence.

production_certification_evidence.scope: internal deterministic evidence evaluation, license eligibility, immutable grant creation and append-only lifecycle receipts; no autonomous legal attestation, contract signature or provider write

authority_invariant: No institutional-control Penta manufactures legal, financial, privacy, identity, procurement, contractual, data, records, quality, regulatory or provider authority. Consequential actions require a traceable CHLOM/DAIL authority source, accountable owner, required PentaHybrid human gate and certified provider binding.

systems.purpose: Maintain obligation inventories, applicability matrices, control mappings, evidence requirements, compliance calendars, exceptions, attestations and remediation routing across CrownThrive programs and providers.
systems.human_surface: Compliance register, obligation matrix, evidence queue, exceptions, attestations and remediation status
systems.authority_boundary: PentaCompliance maps and tests adopted obligations but cannot discover or invent a regulatory duty, declare universal legal compliance, waive an obligation, file a binding attestation or override PentaLegal, PentaPolicy, PentaOFAC or accountable human authority.
systems.production_scope: deterministic internal obligation applicability and evidence-sufficiency control plane; binding attestations and external filings remain gated

five_stage.discover: Resolve applicable adopted obligations, controls, owners and evidence gaps.
five_stage.govern: Bind obligations to authoritative sources, scope, due dates, exceptions and accountable owners.
five_stage.execute: Route evidence collection, attestations, remediation and escalation through authorized lanes.
five_stage.verify: Reconcile control evidence, exceptions and attestations to the governing requirement.
five_stage.preserve: Retain obligation lineage, evidence, dispositions, exceptions and remediation history.

systems.purpose: Govern privacy inventories, data-subject rights, consent, minimization, purpose limitation, retention, privacy-impact reviews and privacy incident routing.
systems.human_surface: Privacy inventory, consent/purpose registry, rights-request queue, DPIA-style reviews and retention exceptions
systems.authority_boundary: PentaPrivacy administers privacy controls but cannot fabricate consent, waive statutory rights, disclose restricted data, silently broaden a processing purpose or make binding legal determinations without PentaLegal and accountable authority.

five_stage.discover: Identify personal/sensitive data, processing purposes, subjects, locations and applicable rights.
five_stage.govern: Apply purpose, consent, minimization, retention, access and jurisdiction rules.
five_stage.execute: Route authorized rights requests, reviews, corrections, deletions or restrictions.
five_stage.verify: Confirm requested action and downstream copies/providers reconcile to the approved disposition.
five_stage.preserve: Retain privacy decision lineage without retaining prohibited secret or excess personal data.

systems.purpose: Govern human, agent, service and organizational identities, role bindings, lifecycle state, authentication context, entitlement requests and separation-of-duties relationships.
systems.human_surface: Identity directory, role/capability bindings, joiner-mover-leaver state, access reviews and conflict checks
systems.authority_boundary: Identity proof or authentication does not create role authority. PentaIdentity cannot self-grant privilege, mint unauthorized roles, bypass PentaCredentials/provider controls or treat membership as governance authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve subject identity, authentication context, current roles, entitlements and conflicts.
five_stage.govern: Apply role, least-privilege, separation-of-duties, lifecycle and approval policy.
five_stage.execute: Route authorized identity and entitlement lifecycle changes through certified providers.
five_stage.verify: Read back effective identity/role state and detect orphaned or excess access.
five_stage.preserve: Retain non-secret identity, approval, access-review and revocation lineage.

systems.purpose: Govern institutional data classification, ownership, stewardship, lineage, quality contracts, schemas, data products, sharing boundaries and lifecycle rules.
systems.human_surface: Data catalog, classification, owners/stewards, lineage, quality contracts and sharing approvals
systems.authority_boundary: PentaData governs data semantics and handling; it cannot silently alter source truth, disclose restricted datasets, override privacy/security rules or infer permission to reuse data for a new purpose.

five_stage.discover: Catalog datasets, schemas, owners, lineage, classifications and quality state.
five_stage.govern: Apply classification, stewardship, sharing, schema and lifecycle policy.
five_stage.execute: Publish authorized schemas/data products and route governed transformations.
five_stage.verify: Validate lineage, schema compatibility, quality checks and access/readback state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain versioned schemas, lineage, quality evidence and stewardship decisions.

systems.purpose: Manage institutional record classes, retention schedules, legal/administrative holds, disposition eligibility, evidentiary integrity and authoritative-record designation.
systems.human_surface: Records schedule, hold register, authoritative-record map, disposition queue and evidence chain
systems.authority_boundary: PentaRecords cannot destroy records under hold, invent retention authority, alter historical evidence, supersede PentaGeneration/PentaDocs archival truth or dispose of records without an authorized schedule and disposition.

five_stage.discover: Identify record classes, custodians, authoritative copies, holds and retention clocks.
five_stage.govern: Apply approved retention, hold, sensitivity, archival and disposition rules.
five_stage.execute: Route authorized preservation, hold, archival or disposition actions.
five_stage.verify: Confirm record integrity, hold compliance and disposition readback.
five_stage.preserve: Retain immutable disposition/hold evidence and provenance.

systems.purpose: Govern procurement intake, sourcing, comparison, requisitions, approvals, purchasing packets, receiving and procurement evidence across goods and services.
systems.human_surface: Requisition queue, sourcing comparisons, approvals, receiving, spend-envelope and procurement evidence
systems.authority_boundary: PentaProcure can prepare and route procurement but cannot commit funds, place an order, accept vendor terms, sign contracts or expand spend authority without PentaCost/PentaPay/PentaCapital/PentaContracts and accountable approval.

five_stage.discover: Resolve need, requirements, budget envelope, approved sources and alternatives.
five_stage.govern: Apply sourcing, conflict, spend, approval, security and contractual policy.
five_stage.execute: Issue authorized requisition/purchase packets through certified provider rails.
five_stage.verify: Reconcile order, receipt, invoice, entitlement and provider state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain sourcing rationale, approvals, receipts and procurement lineage.

systems.purpose: Govern vendor/provider onboarding, due diligence, ownership, risk, service levels, renewals, performance, dependencies, concentration and offboarding.
systems.human_surface: Vendor register, due-diligence packets, SLA/performance, risk, renewal and offboarding views
systems.authority_boundary: PentaVendor evaluates and manages relationships but cannot accept provider terms, sign agreements, create credentials, approve spend or certify technical execution paths on behalf of PentaLegal, PentaCredentials or PentaCertify.

five_stage.discover: Resolve vendor identity, services, dependencies, terms, ownership and evidence.
five_stage.govern: Apply due diligence, risk, security, SLA, concentration and renewal policy.
five_stage.execute: Route onboarding, review, renewal, remediation or offboarding actions.
five_stage.verify: Reconcile service, risk, certification and contractual state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain due diligence, evaluations, renewals and offboarding evidence.

systems.purpose: Manage contract intake, templates, clause matrices, negotiation packets, approval routing, signatures, obligations, milestones, renewals, amendments and termination tracking.
systems.human_surface: Contract workspace, clause matrix, approval/signature state, obligations, renewals and termination alerts
systems.authority_boundary: PentaContracts administers lifecycle mechanics and evidence. It cannot practice law, accept terms, sign, amend, waive, terminate or bind CrownThrive without PentaLegal review and authorized human/signatory authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve parties, terms, templates, obligations, owners and deadlines.
five_stage.govern: Apply legal, policy, signatory, risk, data and records requirements.
five_stage.execute: Route drafts, reviews, approvals and authorized signature-provider actions.
five_stage.verify: Confirm executed copy, signatories, obligations and provider receipt state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain authoritative versions, approvals, signatures, obligations and amendment lineage.

systems.purpose: Evaluate exact asset rights profiles and license requests; prepare or create immutable internal grant records; route reviewed/provider issuance; and maintain append-only amendment, renewal, suspension, revocation and public-verification evidence.
systems.human_surface: Asset rights profiles, eligibility decisions, license requests, immutable grants, lifecycle events, holds and public-safe verification
systems.authority_boundary: PentaLicense cannot manufacture ownership, control, chain of title, sublicensing authority, legal advice, pricing, contractual acceptance, signatory power or provider truth. It may issue only within an exact adopted rights profile and terms; D3 and reviewed lanes remain human-gated; provider effects require certified bindings and readback.
systems.production_scope: deterministic internal eligibility, immutable grant records and append-only lifecycle receipts; binding legal/provider actions remain authority-gated

five_stage.discover: Resolve asset identity/version/hash, rights-control evidence, requested rights, parties, territory, media, term and restrictions.
five_stage.govern: Apply CHLOM authority, compliance, contract, identity, commercial, risk and human-review gates.
five_stage.execute: Create an immutable internal grant or route an authorized provider issuance without bypassing required gates.
five_stage.verify: Read back provider/grant state, reconcile exact terms and expose only the public-safe verification projection.
five_stage.preserve: Retain immutable grants and append-only amendment, renewal, suspension and revocation events.

systems.purpose: Govern quality standards, acceptance criteria, nonconformances, corrective/preventive actions, root-cause analysis, quality plans and continuous-improvement evidence across software and operations.
systems.human_surface: Quality plans, acceptance criteria, nonconformance/CAPA queue, root-cause and trend views
systems.authority_boundary: PentaQuality defines and evaluates quality controls but cannot self-certify a release, erase nonconformances, lower acceptance criteria after failure or replace PentaAssure/PentaAudit independence requirements.

five_stage.discover: Resolve applicable quality standards, criteria, defects and trend signals.
five_stage.govern: Apply quality plan, independence, severity and remediation policy.
five_stage.execute: Route tests, nonconformances, root-cause and corrective/preventive actions.
five_stage.verify: Retest corrective action and confirm acceptance criteria remain satisfied.
five_stage.preserve: Retain quality plans, findings, CAPA lineage and effectiveness evidence.
